claimAssessments.statement: Read test.js and observed it requires './src/total.js' and asserts total([1,2,3])===6 and total([])===0, exiting 0 only when both pass.
Read src/total.js and observed the pre-fix loop bound `for (let i = 0; i < xs.length - 1; i++)`.
Edited src/total.js, replacing the loop bound `i < xs.length - 1` with `i < xs.length`. Post-edit read confirms line 3 is now `for (let i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) sum += xs[i];`.
Attempted to run `node test.js` to capture the suite exit code; the Bash tool call was refused by the environment's permission mode and no test process executed.
